subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should OpenClaw accept this complete Wear companion surface—including Phone-proxied agent/Gateway controls and durable local theme/Auto-Speak preferences—as the supported long-term Android product contract?
rationale: The implementation can be technically sound while still establishing a larger user-facing Wear scope and a durable state-owner contract that repository policy reserves for maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the restored companion contract
options.body: Accept the full capability-negotiated Wear experience and its local preference ownership as the supported product direction, then merge after normal exact-head checks finish.

options.title: Require a narrower state boundary
options.body: Keep the supported companion controls but require the durable settings implementation to move to the maintainer-approved state owner before merge.

options.title: Narrow the companion scope
options.body: Retain only the already-approved companion behaviors and defer agent, Gateway, or local-settings additions to a separately sponsored proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve the restored companion contract
recommendation.body: Accept the full capability-negotiated Wear experience and its local preference ownership as the supported product direction, then merge after normal exact-head checks finish.
